title: Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2610.40075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. translated_title: 从二元可行性查询器中学习安全的流匹配机器人策略
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型日益依赖基于流的动作生成来实现通用操作，然而生成的动作无法保证满足关节限位和碰撞避免等物理约束。当可行集无法用解析方式描述、只能通过黑盒可行性查询器访问时，这一问题尤为具有挑战性。我们研究了这种仅依赖查询器的实际场景，提出了一种由查询器引导的可微安全防护机制，用于实现安全的流匹配机器人策略。该防护机制在正向传播中利用二元可行性查询来修正不安全的更新，同时提取局部边界信息，以便在反向传播中提供约束感知的学习信号。结合离散时间流匹配，同一防护机制在训练和推理阶段均被使用，从而在无需显式或可微约束模型的情况下，实现前向-后向对齐的策略学习。实验在（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种由黑盒二元可行性查询器引导的可微安全防护机制，在流匹配机器人策略的正向传播中修正不安全动作、在反向传播中提供约束感知的学习信号，从而在无需显式约束模型的情况下实现安全的策略学习与推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for flow-matching robot policies that corrects unsafe actions via binary feasibility queries in the forward pass and provides constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass, enabling safe policy learning without explicit constraint models.
